title: ScenarioEnvelope
description: Top-level scenario document wrapping all four output layers of a asago-scenario-generator scenario.

scenario_id.description: Collision-safe, run-specific identifier: scenario:<version>:<256-bit hex digest of run_id|candidate_id|attempt>.

candidate_id.description: Stable canonical candidate identity (cand:v2:<128-bit hex>) that produced this scenario.

attack_complexity_assessment.description: Closed, versioned deterministic attack-complexity assessment (cmps.7): candidate lower bound, final required capability level, rule version, typed reasons, and evidence - persisted separately from the immutable actor_profile.capability_level.

behavior_spec.description: Structured behavior specification with projection-traceable actions and assertions. Pre-alpha: no raw string/dict loophole on the authoritative envelope (422o.4).

source_influence_provenance.description: Typed source-influence provenance block linking projected attack-tree leaves and narrative steps to the declared threat sources, mitigations, and capability constraints in taxonomy scenario envelopes, with deterministic qualification metrics and pass/fail status. Absent until source-influence provenance is declared for the scenario.

projection.description: Deeply immutable, standalone canonical projection snapshot with execution requirements and artifact realization mappings. Every generated scenario must embed exactly one projection block.

rule_version.description: Closed version of the deterministic rule table used.

candidate_lower_bound.description: Lower bound on actor capability computed from typed candidate-v2 projection inputs before Call 0.

final.description: Final required level computed after typed realized actions exist; inherits the candidate lower bound and may only raise it.

AttackComplexityAssessment.description: Closed, versioned attack-complexity assessment record (cmps.7): candidate lower bound and final required capability level with typed reasons, persisted separately from the immutable actor capability.

kind.description: Which typed input surface the reference points at.

ref_id.description: Stable identifier of the referenced input: canonical chain step_id, execution requirement_id, attack-tree node id, or the access-provenance initial_entry_point_id.

reasons.description: Reasons that fired in this phase, ordered deterministically by descending required level then ascending rule_id, deduplicated by rule_id. Empty when the phase assesses as novice.

required_level.description: Capability level this rule requires when it fires.

detail.description: Structured explanation of the trigger, including observed values (e.g. step counts) so the reason stands alone.

evidence.description: Typed references to the exact inputs that fired the rule.

projected_step_ids.description: Canonical projected step IDs that this narrative step realizes. Required (non-empty).

realizations.description: Per-projected-step canonical realization records. Derived in post-processing.
realizations.title: Realizations

NarrativeAccessRealization.description:
Typed narrative access realization reference (cmps.6).

Links the narrative to the actor's structured access provenance without
relying on prose keyword matching.  The fields must exactly agree with
``ActorAccessProvenance`` — this is a cross-artifact invariant, not a
keyword check.

initial_entry_point_id.description: Canonical entry-point name of the initial ingress this narrative realizes.  Must match actor access provenance.
initial_entry_point_id.title: Initial Entry Point Id

influence_source.description: Canonical entry-point name of the upstream influence source, if indirect.  Must match actor access provenance.
influence_source.title: Influence Source

influence_source_kind.description: Typed kind of the canonical upstream influence source.
influence_source_kind.title: Influence Source Kind

influence_source_id.description: Canonical upstream influence source ID, if indirect.
influence_source_id.title: Influence Source Id

trust_boundary_id.description: Canonical trust boundary name of the boundary crossed, if indirect.  Must match actor access provenance.
trust_boundary_id.title: Trust Boundary Id

responsible_step_number.description: Step number in the narrative where the actor realizes the initial access described by the provenance block.
responsible_step_number.title: Responsible Step Number

NarrativeAccessRealization.title: NarrativeAccessRealization

projected_step_ids.description: Canonical projected step IDs that this tree leaf realizes. Controlled many-to-many.

realizations.description: Per-projected-step canonical realization records. Required (non-empty) when projected_step_ids is non-empty.

ActorAccessProvenance.description:
Typed evidence linking an actor to the scenario's canonical initial ingress.

Replaces blanket direct/indirect actor allowlists and keyword insider
checks with structured access provenance grounded in the canonical
entry-point identity (cmps.6).

Two distinct concepts are modelled:

- ``ingress_mode`` — the channel controllability of the pinned entry
  point, derived from its canonical ``effective_controllability``.
  This is **never** LLM-inferred; it is authoritative.
- ``access_class`` — the actor's relationship to the system
  (``public``, ``authenticated``, ``privileged``, ``supply_chain``).
  This is LLM-generated and validated against the ingress mode and
  actor type.

Evidence fields:

- ``indirect`` ingress requires ``influence_source`` (a canonical
  ``entry_point_id`` resolvable in the profile), ``influence_mechanism``,
  and ``trust_boundary_id`` (a canonical ``tb:v1:…`` referencing a
  ``TrustBoundary`` declared in the profile).  The boundary's
  ``to_zone`` must match the pinned entry point's
  ``effective_ingress_zone``, and the influence source must not be
  the same as the initial ingress (no self-relation unless explicitly
  modeled).
- Insider actors using ``direct`` ingress require
  ``material_insider_advantage`` regardless of ``access_class`` —
  enum choice is not evidence.

initial_entry_point_id.description: Canonical entry-point ID inherited from the initial ingress.  The scenario must inherit exactly one.
initial_entry_point_id.title: Initial Entry Point Id

ingress_mode.description: Channel controllability of the pinned entry point, derived from its canonical effective controllability: 'direct' (actor types input directly) or 'indirect' (actor influences an upstream data source).  Never LLM-inferred.
ingress_mode.title: Ingress Mode

access_class.description: Actor access class describing the actor's relationship to the system: 'public' (no auth), 'authenticated' (registered user), 'privileged' (elevated/internal access), 'supply_chain' (upstream supply-chain position).
access_class.title: Access Class

influence_source.description: Canonical entry-point ID of the upstream data source the actor influences (required for indirect ingress mode). Must resolve in the capability profile.
influence_source.title: Influence Source

influence_source_kind.description: Typed kind of the canonical upstream influence source.
influence_source_kind.title: Influence Source Kind

influence_source_id.description: Canonical upstream influence source ID, if indirect.
influence_source_id.title: Influence Source Id

influence_mechanism.description: How the actor exerts influence — e.g. poisoning, injection, staging (required for indirect ingress mode).
influence_mechanism.title: Influence Mechanism

trust_boundary_id.description: Canonical trust boundary ID referencing a TrustBoundary declared in the capability profile (required for indirect ingress mode).  The boundary's to_zone must match the pinned entry point's effective_ingress_zone.
trust_boundary_id.title: Trust Boundary Id

material_insider_advantage.description: Structured material insider advantage beyond public access (required for insider actors using public/authenticated access with direct ingress).
material_insider_advantage.title: Material Insider Advantage

ActorAccessProvenance.title: ActorAccessProvenance

ProjectionEnvelopeBlock.description:
Deeply immutable, standalone canonical projection persisted on the envelope.

Carries the full immutable projection snapshot, derived execution
requirements, projected taxonomy mappings, canonical ingress identity,
and artifact realization mappings.  Every generated artifact receives
the same fixed projection constraints; generated content realizes but
never chooses or mutates the projection.

capability_snapshot.description: Full immutable CapabilityFactSnapshot embedded so controllability can be derived from evidence during standalone validation.

ProjectionEnvelopeBlock.title: ProjectionEnvelopeBlock

ProjectionTraceabilityViolation.description: A single typed traceability violation attributed to a generated stage.
ProjectionTraceabilityViolation.title: ProjectionTraceabilityViolation

ProjectionTraceabilityViolationCode.description: Typed violation codes for projection traceability failures.
ProjectionTraceabilityViolationCode.title: ProjectionTraceabilityViolationCode

ProjectionTraceabilityStage.description: Earliest responsible generated stage for a traceability violation.
ProjectionTraceabilityStage.title: ProjectionTraceabilityStage

ArtifactRealizationMapping.description:
Map one generated artifact element to one or more projected steps.

Controlled many-to-many realization (contract §5): one artifact element
may realize multiple projected steps (combine), and one projected step
may be realized by multiple artifact elements (split).  The total order
of projected steps must be preserved across element ordering within the
same artifact stage.

element_id.description: Generated artifact element identifier: narrative step number as a string, attack-tree leaf node id, or behavior step reference.
element_id.title: Element Id

projected_step_ids.description: One or more projected step IDs from the projection's selected_step_ids.  Must be unique within this mapping.
projected_step_ids.title: Projected Step Ids

ArtifactRealizationMapping.title: ArtifactRealizationMapping

ArtifactStage.description: Generated artifact stage that realizes projected steps.
ArtifactStage.title: ArtifactStage

AssertionRealizationMapping.description:
Map a generated behavior assertion to projected observable postconditions.

Assertions map to projected observable postconditions (contract §4), not
mechanically to setup steps.  Each assertion traces to one or more
postconditions owned by one or more selected projected steps.

source_step_ids.description: Projected step IDs that own the postconditions this assertion verifies.  Must be unique within this mapping.
source_step_ids.title: Source Step Ids

projected_postcondition_ids.description: Observable postcondition IDs from the projected steps.  Must be unique within this mapping and resolvable in the source steps.
projected_postcondition_ids.title: Projected Postcondition Ids

AssertionRealizationMapping.title: AssertionRealizationMapping

ObservableOutcomeLink.description:
Explicit link from a step's postcondition to an observable outcome.

Declares that a postcondition is observable through a specific resource
slot as a specific observation kind.  The derivation consumes this link
to produce an :class:`ObservationRequirement`.
ObservableOutcomeLink.title: ObservableOutcomeLink

TaxonomyContext.description:
Pinned taxonomy releases; LAAF is optional and non-authoritative for v1.

An absent ``laaf`` pin means the context is ATLAS-only: any LAAF mapping
decision in the chain then fails closed.  An explicit pin is meaningful
only when the qualifying resolver pins the identical context and carries
authoritative LAAF membership for every exact id.
TaxonomyContext.title: TaxonomyContext

StepResourceLink.description:
Explicit link from a step to a required resource slot.

The ``role`` declares how the slot is used by the step, determining the
execution-requirement derivation.  No inference from action kind, name,
or cardinality is performed by the projection — the link is the sole
authority for requirement derivation.

For ``source_influence`` links the ``slot_id`` is the upstream source
slot (an entry point or integration the attacker influences outside the
trust boundary), ``trust_boundary_slot_id`` is the boundary the source
content crosses, and ``target_ingress_slot_id`` is the canonical ingress
entry point the influenced content flows into.  The target-ingress edge
is explicit: the projection never assumes the chain's initial ingress
implicitly supplies this relation.
StepResourceLink.title: StepResourceLink

SourceInfluenceArtifactKind.description: Generated artifact element kind covered by source-influence provenance.
SourceInfluenceArtifactKind.title: SourceInfluenceArtifactKind

SourceInfluenceArtifactLink.description:
A provenance link from one artifact element to typed source records.

The recorded ``projected_step_id`` is the step the link claims the
artifact realizes; qualification verifies it against the artifact's
actual realized projected steps.

artifact_kind.description: Generated artifact stage the linked element belongs to.

artifact_id.description: Generated artifact element identifier this link attaches to (leaf id or narrative step number as a string).
artifact_id.title: Artifact Id

projected_step_id.description: Projected step ID this link claims the artifact realizes.  Must match one of the artifact's realized projected steps.
projected_step_id.title: Projected Step Id

source_refs.description: Typed source records this artifact is linked to.  Must resolve against the declared source universe and include every source type.
source_refs.title: Source Refs

SourceInfluenceArtifactLink.title: SourceInfluenceArtifactLink

projected_leaf_coverage.description: Covered projected leaves over all provenance-carrying leaves.

narrative_step_coverage.description: Covered narrative steps over all narrative steps.

source_reference_coverage.description: Declared source records referenced at least once over all declared records.

orphaned_source_count.description: Declared source records never referenced by any artifact link.
orphaned_source_count.title: Orphaned Source Count

unreferenced_artifact_count.description: Artifact elements carrying no provenance link at all.
unreferenced_artifact_count.title: Unreferenced Artifact Count

SourceInfluenceProvenanceBlock.description:
Typed source-influence provenance block persisted on the envelope.

Carries the scenario-level declared source universe (stored once),
the per-artifact links for projected leaves and narrative steps, and
the deterministic qualification metrics plus status.  Envelope-level
validation recomputes the qualification from the envelope's actual
artifacts and rejects stale or tampered persisted metadata.

declared_sources.description: Scenario-level declared source universe: each typed source record is stored exactly once.
declared_sources.title: Declared Sources

leaf_links.description: Provenance links for projected attack-tree leaves.
leaf_links.title: Leaf Links

metrics.description: Deterministic qualification metrics for this block.

status.description: Persisted qualification status for this block.
status.title: Status

SourceInfluenceProvenanceBlock.title: SourceInfluenceProvenanceBlock

SourceInfluenceSourceRef.description: One declared source record in the scenario's provenance universe.

source_type.description: Typed source category: threat_source, mitigation, or capability_constraint.

source_id.description: Stable source identifier from the taxonomy scenario envelope vocabulary, e.g. 'threat:T12', 'mitigation:M12', or 'constraint:KCX-MAGENT'.
source_id.title: Source Id

SourceInfluenceSourceRef.title: SourceInfluenceSourceRef

SourceInfluenceSourceType.description: Typed source categories referenced by source-influence provenance.
SourceInfluenceSourceType.title: SourceInfluenceSourceType

ProjectionSnapshot.description: Local structural/pure semantic parse; use qualification for external facts.
ProjectionSnapshot.title: ProjectionSnapshot

AgentInternalResourceReference.description:
Canonical reference to agent-internal state.

Agent-internal state is data assembled or transformed within the
agent's own working context — neither an external entry point, tool,
integration, nor trust boundary.  It is the intrinsic singleton working
state of the profiled agent, so it requires no adapter inventory identity.
Candidate-v2 resolves exactly this typed singleton rather than laundering
it through an unrelated tool or integration binding.
AgentInternalResourceReference.title: AgentInternalResourceReference

AuthoritativeFactReference.description: Reference to a pre-existing authoritative fact (never a generated artifact).
AuthoritativeFactReference.title: AuthoritativeFactReference

OutputSurfaceResourceReference.description:
Canonical reference to an output-direction entry point.

An output surface is the agent's rendered-response surface — the
model's output that a client renders or fetches.  It is distinct from
an input entry point (``EntryPointResourceReference``) even though
both resolve to an :class:`EntryPoint` in the capability profile:
only entry points with ``direction == "output"`` qualify as output
surfaces.
OutputSurfaceResourceReference.title: OutputSurfaceResourceReference

BehaviorAction.description:
A structured behavior spec action tied to a projected step.

Each behavior action carries the canonical projected step ID it
realizes and the tree leaf it was derived from, enabling deterministic
traceability without Gherkin parsing.

metadata so the validator can reconcile per-step semantics at the
behavior boundary.

action_id.description: Stable behavior action identifier, deterministically derived from the tree leaf ID (e.g. 'ba-<leaf_id>').
action_id.title: Action Id

source_leaf_id.description: Attack tree leaf node ID this behavior action was derived from.
source_leaf_id.title: Source Leaf Id

gherkin_keyword.title: Gherkin Keyword

text.title: Text

projected_step_ids.description: Canonical projected step IDs this behavior action realizes.

BehaviorAction.title: BehaviorAction

BehaviorAssertion.description:
A structured behavior assertion tied to projected postconditions.

Assertions map to projected observable postconditions, not to setup
steps.  Each assertion carries the canonical postcondition IDs and
source step IDs it verifies.

source_step_ids.title: Source Step Ids

projected_postcondition_ids.description: Observable postcondition IDs this assertion verifies.
projected_postcondition_ids.title: Projected Postcondition Ids

Carries structured actions and assertions with canonical projected

Validation can cross-check the structured elements against the
rendered Gherkin and the projection block without parsing Gherkin.

assertions.description: Structured behavior assertions tied to projected postconditions.

BoundaryConfidence.description: Whether a trust boundary was explicit, inferred, or hypothesized.

Evidence/completeness state for entry-point and tool inventories.

``inferred_partial``: inference establishes presence, never absence.
``operator_confirmed_complete``: only an operator-reviewed profile may
declare this, with explicit evidence sources.  Ordinary LLM output
cannot self-promote.

MemoryPersistence.title: MemoryPersistence

CapabilityFactSnapshot.title: CapabilityFactSnapshot

CapabilityProfile.description:
Capability profile artifact for a system under assessment.

Stage 1 fields (required) determine threat scope.
Stage 2 fields (optional) determine scenario specificity.

Boolean capability flags (``has_persistent_memory``, ``multi_agent``,
``hitl``) are computed properties derived solely from ``kc_subcodes``.
They cannot be set directly.  Legacy YAML profiles that include these
fields will have them silently stripped with a deprecation warning.

zones_active.description: Schneider zones active in the system. Minimum ['input', 'reasoning']. Other zones: 'tool_execution', 'memory', 'inter_agent'.
zones_active.title: Zones Active

entry_points.description: Attack entry points, each with a name, direction tag, and optional controllability. Direction is one of: input (attacker can send data in), output (system sends data out), bidirectional (both). Controllability is one of: direct (user types input), indirect (attacker influences data source), system (fully system-controlled), or null (inferred later).
entry_points.title: Entry Points

kc_subcodes.description: OWASP KC (Key Component) sub-codes identifying the system's granular capabilities. E.g. ['KC1.1', 'KC4.1', 'KC6.1.1']. Must contain at least one code.
kc_subcodes.title: Kc Subcodes

tool_inventory.description: Tools and APIs the system can invoke.  Required when 'tool_execution' is in zones_active.  Prevents phantom tool hallucination in downstream scenario generation.
tool_inventory.title: Tool Inventory

entry_point_completeness.description: Evidence/completeness state for the entry-point inventory. Inferred profiles are always 'inferred_partial'. Only operator-reviewed profiles may declare 'operator_confirmed_complete' with entry_point_evidence.

entry_point_evidence.description: Explicit evidence sources for operator_confirmed_complete entry-point inventory. Required when entry_point_completeness is operator_confirmed_complete.
entry_point_evidence.title: Entry Point Evidence

tool_inventory_completeness.description: Evidence/completeness state for the tool inventory. Inferred profiles are always 'inferred_partial'. Only operator-reviewed profiles may declare 'operator_confirmed_complete' with tool_inventory_evidence.

tool_inventory_evidence.description: Explicit evidence sources for operator_confirmed_complete tool inventory. Required when tool_inventory_completeness is operator_confirmed_complete.
tool_inventory_evidence.title: Tool Inventory Evidence

tool_types.description: Tools and APIs the system can invoke (populated at moderate/thorough depth).
tool_types.title: Tool Types

data_flows.description: Data flows between zones and components (populated at moderate/thorough depth).
data_flows.title: Data Flows

trust_boundaries.description: Trust boundaries in the system architecture (populated at thorough depth).
trust_boundaries.title: Trust Boundaries

memory_mechanisms.description: Memory and state persistence mechanisms (populated at moderate/thorough depth).
memory_mechanisms.title: Memory Mechanisms

external_integrations.description: External systems the agent integrates with (populated at moderate/thorough depth).
external_integrations.title: External Integrations

EntryPoint.description:
An entry point with a direction tag indicating data flow.

Direction controls whether the entry point is considered as attacker
ingress during candidate expansion:
- ``input``: attacker can send data in (included in candidate cross-product)
- ``output``: system sends data out only (excluded from candidate cross-product)
- ``bidirectional``: both input and output (included in candidate cross-product)

Controllability (optional) indicates how directly an attacker can
influence data through this entry point:
- ``direct``: attacker types input directly (e.g. chat prompt)
- ``indirect``: attacker can influence a data source (e.g. RAG poisoning)
- ``system``: fully system-controlled, not attacker-accessible
- ``None``: inferred at runtime by keyword heuristic

The model is frozen (immutable) so that submitted metadata cannot be
mutated after the filter protocol has been engaged.

name.description: Entry point description, e.g. 'user prompts via chat widget'.
name.title: Name

entry_point_type.description: Typed ingress mechanism. This is adapter-neutral semantic metadata; it does not derive from the entry-point name.
entry_point_type.title: Entry Point Type

direction.description: Data flow direction: 'input' (attacker can send data in), 'output' (system sends data out), or 'bidirectional' (both).
direction.title: Direction

controllability.description: Attacker controllability: 'direct' (user types input), 'indirect' (attacker can influence data source), 'system' (fully system-controlled). When None, inferred by keyword heuristic.
controllability.title: Controllability

ingress_zone.description: Canonical Schneider zone for initial ingress through this entry point. When None, inferred from direction: input→input, bidirectional→input, output→output. This establishes canonical ingress-zone semantics in typed profile data rather than inferring from labels.
ingress_zone.title: Ingress Zone

EntryPoint.title: EntryPoint
